findings.title: Service selects no pods
findings.cause: Service web selects pods with app=web, and no pod in namespace kd-service-selector-mismatch has those labels (the closest are app=webapp)

evidence.command: kubectl get service web -n kd-service-selector-mismatch -o jsonpath='{.spec.selector}'

evidence.what: the closest labels on pods in the namespace are app=webapp

findings.fix: Change the Service's selector from app=web to match the pods (app=webapp), or relabel the pods.
